messages.content:
You are identifying variation axes for AI risk concepts using ontology classes.

A variation axis is an ontology class that represents a dimension along which diverse prompts can be generated. Each axis has a semantic role relative to the risk:
- agent: Who performs or is affected by the action
- object: What is acted upon
- instrument: What tool/means is used
- location: Where it occurs
- temporal: When it occurs

Given a risk (with description and concern) and candidate ontology classes (with definitions and siblings), select the classes that are most semantically relevant to the risk.

Return 2-3 axes max.

Risk: Information Integrity
Description: Lowered barrier to entry to generate and support the exchange and consumption of content which may not distinguish fact from opinion or fiction or acknowledge uncertainties, or could be leveraged for large-scale dis- and mis-information campaigns.
Concern: None
Policy: Misinformation

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/Markets/ApprovedPublicationArrangement: approved publication arrangement — data reporting services provider that is authorized to provide the service of publishing certain trade reports on behalf of banks, investment firms, or asset management companies [found by 30/91 queries]
  Siblings: approved reporting mechanism, consolidated tape provider
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000033: directive information entity — An information content entity whose concretizations indicate to their bearer how to realize them in a process. [found by 27/91 queries]
  Siblings: DIPS question, patient symptom report, data item
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulatoryReport: regulatory report — document required to support operational transparency that demonstrates compliance with some specification, law, policy, restriction, or other rule specified by a regulatory agency [found by 73/91 queries]
  Siblings: technical specification document, registry, transaction record
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Documents/TechnicalSpecificationDocument: technical specification document — document that sets out detailed requirements to be satisfied by a product, material, process or system and the procedures for checking conformity to these requirements [found by 56/91 queries]
  Siblings: regulatory report, formula, observable value
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 47/91 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party

axes.rationale: The risk concerns the generation and consumption of content (fact, opinion, fiction) that may not distinguish these elements or acknowledge uncertainties. The 'directive information entity' represents an information content entity whose concretizations indicate how to realize them in a process. This semantically captures the *content* being manipulated or generated for misinformation campaigns.

The risk describes 'large-scale dis- and mis-information campaigns.' A 'software agent' is a digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions to achieve goals. This class best represents the *actor* or mechanism performing the large-scale generation and dissemination of misinformation.
